Department, Patna

BHANDARY: W ill the Minister of

Commissioner in additional/dual charge,
Patna has performed illegal action by
depriving the Group-C employees of
Scheduled Castes of thier due promotion

BASHA:
SHRI M.V. MYSURA
REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE  be
pleased to state:

Scheduled Banks business in the country
in 2006-07 upto March 2 grew by
22.5 per cent as compared with 23.4 per
cent growth last year;

explain why inflation continued at over 6.4

either been unable or perhaps unwilling to
bring down inflation to less than 2.5 per

Adequate infrastructural facilities to
attract FDI
*463. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are providing
adequate infrastructural facilities to the
companies to attract more FDI;

last three years;
(c) whether Government have identified
some countries in their list to attract more
FDI;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and

undertaken with this amount during the last
three years especially in Andhra Pradesh?
Dependence on oil imports
*464. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is the
third largest oil consuming country in Asia
and imports 70 per cent of its crude to
meet its energy needs;

so far taken to tap more domestic reservoirs
to help offset its growing dependence on
imports alongwith details thereof; and
(c) the budgetary allocations made
during the year 2007-08 in comparison to
the year 2006-07 to meet India's energy
needs?
Extension of ethanol-blended petrol
programme
*465. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to extend ethanol-blended petrol
programme to every part of the country;
(b) if so, the number of States in which
the programme is presently operational and
the number of States where the extension
of ethanol-blended petrol programme is
planned; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Cooperation with Russia in energy
sector
*466. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have signed
an agreement with Russia on cooperation
in energy sector during the recent visit of
the President of Russia;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have made an
assessment of the commercial benefits to
India of such an agreement; and
(d) whether such agreements enhance
the energy security of the country?
Promotion of tourism in North-
Eastern States
*467. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of TOURISM  be pleased to state:
(a) the schemes sanctioned by
Government to promote tourism in North-
Eastern States specially in Sikkim;
(b) the assistance provided by
Government to these State Governments
during each of the last three years alongwith
the amount spent by these State
Governments for the purpose; and
(c) the steps taken in that regard during
the Ninth Plan and proposed for the Tenth
Plan?

147
Compassionate appointment to
dependents of deceased employees in
banks
*468. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of FINANCE  be pleased to state:
(a) how many employees have died in
harness in different Public Sector Banks
during the last three years;
(b) out of these cases, how many
dependents of the deceased have been given
compassionate appointment;
(c) whether it is a fact that the Public
Sector Banks have stopped recruitment on
compassionate grounds; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Pay revision of PSU employees
*469. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) the approximate number of
employees working in the various Public
Sector Enterprises/Undertakings in the
country;
(b) whether Government have set up a
Committee for the pay revision of PSU
employees;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) by when its report is likely to be
submitted to Government; and
(e) whether Government propose to
grant interim relief to the employees till
the recommendations are accepted?

under AIBP
*470. DR. GY AN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the status of various projects
undertaken in Rajasthan, under Accelerated
Irrigation Benefit Programme, during the
last three years;
(b) the targeted time for completion of
each of the above projects and physical
achievements till date;
(c) whether some of the projects are
lagging behind the schedule;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor, project-
wise, cost escalation due to delay; and
(e) the details of the measures taken to
speed up execution of such projects?
Ethno-graphic studies on tribals by
Anthropological Survey of India
*471. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
system or process by which constant and
regular monitoring of tribals’ progress is
done through ethno-graphic studies under
the aegis of the Anthropological Survey of
India;
(b) if so, the prevalent system in this
regard;
(c) what degree of credibility does the
ethno-graphic studies done by ASI enjoy;

studies are not done on social status of
tribals; and

city

the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Dwarka city
discovered by archaeologists at the sea shore
of Gujarat in 1994 is getting destroyed due
to sea waves and tides;
(b) if so,  the efforts made by
Department of Archaeology for its
maintenance; and
(c) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to develop this site
as a submerged tourist spot?
Special Purpose Vehicle for
infrastructure projects
*473. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Chairman, HDFC Bank
has submitted in February, 2007, a report
suggesting setting up a Special Purpose
Vehicle abroad, for collecting funds there
and then lending to Indian companies and
also to finance import of capital goods used
for infrastructure projects;
(b) if so, when and where such a  SPV
would come into operation; and
(c) whether such collection of funds
from abroad will adversely affect our foreign
exchange reserves in future?
LPG connections for commercial use
†*474. SHRI DILIP SINGH JUDEV :
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a) the number of LPG connections
provided to each State for commercial use
during the last three years, State-wise;
(b) the number of applications in the
waiting list, State-wise;
(c) the number of cases of commercial
use of gas for domestic purposes that has
come to light during the last few years,
State-wise; and
(d) the details of the action taken
thereon?
Development of tourist spots in
Kerala
*475. SHRI ABDUL W AHAB
PEEVEE: Will the Minister of TOURISM
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of tourist spots developed
in the State of Kerala during the last three
years, year-wise;
(b) the amount sanctioned and released
during the period; and
(c) the projects sanctioned for the year
2006-07?

Kisan Credit Cards to farmers
†*476. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of farmers who have been
provided Kisan Credit Cards during the last
two and a half years;
(b) the total amount distributed to the
farmers, till date, since the inception of
Kisan Credit Card Scheme;
(c) the total number of  farmers
benefited with the said  scheme until now;
and
(d) the present status of recovery of
loan given to the farmers through Kisan
Credit Cards?
Installation of rain water harvesting
system
*477. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR :
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
insisted that the State Governments
constitute mandatory rules to make
compulsory installation of rain water
harvesting system in all newly and existing
constructions,  buildings and Government
offices;
(b) if so, the details of feedback from
the States and how many States have made
rules for compulsory installation of rain
water harvesting systems in the new
constructions; and
(c) the annual grant during the last year
made by the Central Government to the
States to improve numbers in installation
of rain water harvesting system in all States?
Survey to assess delays of Indian
flights
*478. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
cognizance of recurrent delays of the flights
of Indian;
(b) whether Government make random
surveys to assess the recurrent delays of
flights;

Modernization of non-metro airports
3502. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to modernize the clusters of non-metro
airports through private companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the names of the airports which are
proposed to be modernized; and
(c) what are the names of companies
which have been short-listed for this
purpose, including the details of the bids
offered by each?
Expansion and modernization of
airports in Tamil Nadu
3503. SHRI B.S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Tamil Nadu had requested the Ministry to
expand airports at Coimbatore, Trichy,
Madurai and Tuticorin and also requested
for modernization of Madurai and Trichy
airports;
(b) if so, the steps taken by the
Ministry in this regard;
(c) whether speedy action will be taken
to expand and modernize the Madurai
airport with international connectivity; and
(d) if so, the time-frame by which the
said modernization will take place?
Modernization of ATC system
3504. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
modernize air traffic control system and
build safety standards with the assistance
of USA;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this would enhance
navigation in all phases of flight, make
routing more flexible and efficient, increase
safety of landing, etc.; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bird-hit cases at IGIA
3505. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(a) whether a number of cases of 'bird
hit' and 'Nilgai' on runways at the Indira

reported during the last two years and the
amount of losses incurred; and
(b) if so, the details of steps taken to
check such menace?

†3506. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
increase the number of flights from Delhi
and other places to Patna;
(b) whether Government are working
on a plan to augment the capacity of Patna
Airport and to modernize it;
(c) if so, by when the said work will be
completed;

Bihar also with the recent spurt in aviation

the falling maintenance practices in the

3508. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

procurement?

THAKUR: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that domestic
airlines have increased manifold during the
last three years;

wise;

of air-miss are increasing significantly on
account of number of airlines and aircrafts
increasing much faster than that of adequate
equipment and staff; and

taken to cope with congestion caused by
aircrafts?

SINGH: Will the Minister of CIVIL

private caterers for on-board meal in their
flights;

country

sectors;
(b) the details of the extra-safety
measures undertaken for safe running of

ensure replacement of these aircrafts;

(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?

there is no shortage of air hostesses; and
(d) what are the financial implications

new recruitments?

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

to increase the number of destinations in

between India and Pakistan;
(b) if so, the new destinations selected
for the purpose;
(c) by when the flights would start
operating to the new destinations; and
(d) whether it is a fact that the number
of flights of Indian Airlines to Pakistan have
not been increased due to insufficient
number of passengers?

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
aviation sector is facing acute shortage of

efforts made by Government to deal with

arrangement of training for the pilots in the
Indian aviation sector?

Company Secretaries of India, the Institute
of Chartered Accountants of India and the
Institute of Cost and Works Accountant of
India;

(c) what is the status of its nominees on
these bodies as on date?

vanishing companies

Minister of COMPANY AFFAIRS be

Ministry;

to be taken by the serious frauds office to
contain the instances of vanishing
companies?

or around Humayun's Tomb

SANGHI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:

Government's consideration to construct a
road-link beneath or around Humayun's
Tomb;

the impact of this project over Humayun's
Tomb; if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether his Ministry has taken a

the details thereof?
Fresh/modern look for Taj Mahal

Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any scheme is under
consideration to provide a fresh/modern
look to Taj Mahal by bringing in
improvement in the beauty and looks

(b) if so, the outline thereof;
(c) the estimated cost to be incurred for
the same; and
(d) the time-frame fixed for the
implementation of the said scheme?

Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased

(a) whether it is a fact that there was
objection to the decision taken by the
